title: Migrant Worker Finds Shining Diamond in Mining Site
summary: A migrant worker in a mining site in Panna district found a shining diamond, valued at over $30,000. The discovery is the second time this year that a worker has found a valuable gemstone. The worker's luck changed when he stumbled upon the diamond while digging, and he was able to return home after finding it.
